answer: The comet register is checked at draw time, orchard lists the eligible set, and river seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 55 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time someone pays for every seat it wants. Jury seats open only to identities older than 55 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh swarm has no way to grade its own output. A 416 account operation therefore ties up 39 million dollars of idle capital. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
